paddy_output_kg.instruction: Estimate total paddy output for this planting using the recorded inputs and observed growing-season conditions.
paddy_output_kg.field_description: Hectares is planting area. Agriblock, Variety, Soil Types and Nursery identify the region, crop variety, soil and nursery type. Seedrate, LP manure, nursery area, weed control, fertilizer and pest-control values are source-recorded inputs with source units where supplied. Rain and AI columns are source water variables in mm. Days in a field name identify its growing-season window. Temperature, wind speed in knots, wind direction and humidity give the reported weather summaries.
